title: The nightly report crashes on a blank CSV line
statement: The nightly sales report blows up with an IndexError when the CSV has a blank line in it. Blank lines should just be skipped. Run `python3 -m unittest discover -q` to check.
notes: Needs python3 with the standard library only — no pip, no network, no third-party test runner. PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE keeps the oracle from writing __pycache__ into the tree, so running it does not change the diff the run is judged on. The second language in the corpus: it is here so the harness is not measured against Go alone.
